purpose: Backfill explicit modern source-governance fields for six bounded P1 canonical-dependent sources selected after the measured P1-B audit, while preserving canonical, monitor and held-source state.

selection.method: bounded P1 cohort using canonical dependency, active horizon, governance information value, regional/institutional breadth and domain diversity; not mechanical top-N

eurostat.finding: Eurostat licenses editorial content under CC BY 4.0 and allows reuse of statistical data/metadata with source acknowledgement. Eurostat expressly offers an internet-calendar subscription that automatically receives release-calendar updates. Automation clearance is bounded to the official subscription/feed route, not arbitrary HTML crawling.

bank_of_canada.finding: Bank content may be used/copied/distributed/transmitted subject to attribution and stated conditions. Terms prohibit circumventing request-frequency limits or overburdening the site, so HTML schedule automation remains endpoint-review-required despite existing pilot evidence.

japan_mof.finding: MOF website content is generally under Public Data License v1.0 subject to exceptions. The auction calendar may be altered and later announcement/result surfaces remain distinct. The content licence does not itself establish unrestricted crawler permission.

new_zealand_electoral_commission.finding: The Electoral Commission confirms the 2026 General Election timetable and supplies authoritative factual milestones. No general website reuse licence or express bot/crawler permission was located in the reviewed official-site material, so classification is limited to curated factual metadata and manual authoritative verification.

pboc.finding: Article 21 states that monthly national financial statistics including money supply, credit flow and assets/liabilities are released within 20 days after month-end. This is a source-native expected window, not an exact date. No automation permission is inferred from the HTML rule surface.

un_general_assembly.finding: UNGA mandated-events pages provide authoritative factual event metadata, but general UN website terms permit downloading/copying for personal non-commercial use without redistribution/derivative rights. The route remains manual informational provenance with automation rights held.

set.governance_backfill_basis: Eurostat permits attributed reuse and expressly provides an internet-calendar subscription that automatically receives calendar updates; automated clearance is bounded to the official ICS/feed route and source-native provisional/confirmed status must be preserved.

Bank of Canada schedule content is reusable subject to stated conditions and existing runtime evidence supports pilot verification, while request-frequency/overburdening terms require endpoint-specific operational review before production polling.

Japan MOF applies Public Data License v1.0 to general website content and WORLD SIGNALS has pilot parser evidence; the licence does not itself grant unrestricted polling and auction-calendar alterations must remain distinct reviewed changes.

The Electoral Commission directly confirms the 2026 General Election timetable. Classification is limited to factual milestone metadata; no general website automation permission was identified and government formation is not inferred as a Commission milestone.

PBoC Article 21 is authoritative factual provenance for a monthly latest-publication window within 20 days after month-end; no exact day/time or automated retrieval permission is inferred from the rule page.

UNGA mandated-events pages are authoritative informational references, but general UN website terms limit copying to personal non-commercial use without redistribution/derivative rights; automation remains held absent a specifically authorised route.

WSSRC-EL-BR-001.reason: The TSE electoral-calendar source is not the proper provenance basis for the constitutionally grounded 5 January 2027 presidential inauguration/start date.

WSSRC-CB-009.reason: The current registered SNB decisions/history URL does not directly support the forward monetary-policy assessment schedule described by the source record; repair source scope before governance backfill.
